amendment: RESEARCH_RULES_AMENDMENT_V1 (A1 LO20 gate, A2 rolling, A3 one model per layer, A4 excess-series cluster test)
amount_scale: 20-session mean daily traded amount at t

books.predictive: overlapping MEAN_FORWARD_RETURN excess vs eligible EW

feature_transform: cross-sectional rank in [0,1] per session over eligible names; names without an event in the window are NaN

hypotheses.mechanism: Disclosed trades by major holders (>=5 pct, 董监高 via 股东增减持) and executives (高管持股变动) over a trailing 120-session window, scaled by the stock's own liquidity. US literature: insider net buying predicts returns. A-share literature recorded BEFORE the run: executives show little timing ability on sales; controllers' sales bump then reverse; purchases may carry information. One fitted model on this layer alone; LO20 gate; independence vs ML1 by excess series.
hypotheses.not: FEATURE_SEARCH; WINDOW_SEARCH; HYPERPARAMETER_SEARCH; REFIT_AFTER_RESEARCH; SELECTING_ON_VALIDATION; SWITCHING_BOOK; SPLITTING_BUY_ONLY_AFTER_SEEING_RESULTS

independence_test: A4: corr of excess-vs-EW series vs ML1 (V25 SCORES_ML1_LGBM); > 0.90 = SAME_CLUSTER
insider_pit: HOLDER visible first session strictly after NOTICE_DATE; EXEC visible CHANGE_DATE + 3 sessions (disclosure due within 2 trading days); rows visible after 2024-02-29 dropped
insider_source: Eastmoney datacenter RPT_SHARE_HOLDER_INCREASE (股东增减持, NOTICE_DATE) + RPT_EXECUTIVE_HOLD_DETAILS (高管持股变动, CHANGE_DATE); free
label: cross-sectional rank of open(t+1)->open(t+1+20) return minus 0.5
level1_gate: fixed-split gates (pred net>0 both, excess/IC evidence>=2 both, FDR q=0.05, LO20 capital>0 both) AND excess>0 in >= 4 of 5 rolling blocks
no_search: features, window, transform, label, params and schedule fixed here; one run
universe: all eligible names in the frozen panel; NOT restricted to event names (declared before run)
